This is a senior full stack engineering role at Sharetec Systems, focused on modernizing core banking and lending software used by credit unions. The work spans architecture across backend, frontend, and database layers, along with technical leadership, mentoring, and production reliability. The stack centers on a backend platform such as .NET, Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, or Python, a modern frontend framework like Angular, React, or Vue, relational and document databases including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MongoDB, and cloud infrastructure with Docker and Kubernetes.
